description: Official Python SDK for the Cartesia API: Sonic text to speech, Ink speech to text, voices and voice agents, with sync and async clients.
rules: Use sonic-3.6 for text to speech. The pinned snapshot is sonic-3.6-2026-08-27.
Never use sonic-2, sonic-turbo, sonic-3-2025-10-27, sonic, sonic-english or sonic-multilingual: they are retired and return model_sunsetted. sonic-latest and sonic-3-latest are deprecated aliases.
Use ink-2 for streaming speech to text and ink-whisper for transcribing files.
Let the SDK set the Cartesia-Version header; do not override it.
Never put CARTESIA_API_KEY in browser code. Mint a short-lived access token on the server and use that in the client.
Check https://docs.cartesia.ai/llms.txt for current models and API shapes before writing code from memory.
